intent: Full visual specification of the approved KursoKo hero mascot cutout — documents every observable art-direction detail for regeneration, animation rigging, and brand consistency.

output.framing: full body, head to both shoes, small padding at top and sides, feet near bottom edge
output.background: fully transparent — character isolated, no floor plane, no studio backdrop, no gradient, no ground shadow blob

art_style.aesthetic: stylized non-photoreal mobile-app mascot — vinyl toy / collectible figure quality
art_style.render_engine_look: Blender Cycles toon-shaded export or Unreal Engine stylized avatar
art_style.shading_model: toon-shaded / cel-shaded hybrid with smooth gradient fills on rounded surfaces

outline_treatment.style: clean, consistent, bold black ink-style outlines defining silhouette and major internal features
outline_treatment.weight: uniform medium stroke — not hair-thin, not comic-book thick
outline_treatment.coverage: full character perimeter plus eyes, mouth, hair facet edges, clothing seams, shoe stripe

surface_geometry.body_and_face: smooth rounded volumes with soft ambient occlusion
surface_geometry.hair: distinct low-poly faceted mesh — large flat angular planes, chunky polygonal chunks
surface_geometry.contrast: smooth skin/body vs geometric hair is a deliberate style signature

materials.hoodie: matte cotton fleece with gentle fold shadows
materials.sneakers: matte rubber sole, smooth leather/canvas upper
materials.tablet: matte plastic/gunmetal body, dark glass screen

lighting.key_light: soft directional light from upper-left at ~45°
lighting.fill: gentle ambient fill — no pure black shadow pockets
lighting.shadows: soft contact shadows in hoodie folds, under chin, and hair facet crevices only
lighting.rim_light: minimal — silhouette read comes from outlines more than rim highlights

must_not_look_like: watercolor or soft AI illustration slop

character.role: KursoKo brand mascot — Filipino career-guidance education app
character.archetype: thoughtful college-age student exploring career paths
character.personality_read: calm, intelligent, quietly confident — deciding, not worried
character.ethnicity_read: Filipino / Southeast Asian youth (warm light skin tone)

proportions.head_to_body_ratio: oversized head roughly 2.5× torso height — classic chibi mascot scale
proportions.head: large, round, dominant visual mass
proportions.limbs: short arms and legs relative to head
proportions.hands: rounded cartoon hands, four visible fingers per hand

pose_and_direction.stance: standing upright, relaxed, weight evenly distributed on both feet, feet slightly apart
pose_and_direction.body_orientation: three-quarter view — torso and hips turned toward viewer's LEFT
pose_and_direction.head_direction: face turned toward viewer's LEFT in three-quarter profile — NOT facing camera straight-on
pose_and_direction.gaze: looking toward viewer's left, attentive and contemplative

right_arm.position: bent at elbow, raised to face level
right_arm.gesture: hand curled into loose fist, knuckles/fingertips resting against lower chin and jaw

left_arm.position: tucked against torso, forearm folded across lower chest
left_arm.action: holding tablet vertically against chest/left side

pose_and_direction.expression_energy: quiet confidence — career exploration moment, not stress or confusion

skin_tone.description: warm light tan / fair Filipino youth skin
skin_tone.finish: smooth matte with very subtle peach shading on cheeks

nose.critical_detail: COMPLETELY ABSENT — no nose geometry, no nostrils, no nose bridge, no nose shadow, no nose line, no dot
nose.skin_plane: smooth uninterrupted flat plane between eyes and mouth

eyes.shape: large, round, cartoon almond — dominant facial feature
eyes.highlights: two white circular catchlights per eye (upper-left glossy reflection)
eyes.lashes: minimal — single dark upper lash line, no heavy mascara
eyes.spacing: wide friendly spacing, positioned in lower half of face
eyes.direction: aligned with head — looking toward viewer's left

eyebrows.position: sit high on forehead, outer ends slightly raised
eyebrows.emotion_read: thoughtful, curious — not angry or surprised

mouth.lip_detail: none — single stroke line, no separate upper/lower lip geometry

cheeks.blush: optional very faint soft blush — subtle if present

ears.detail: simple inner-ear C-curve indent, same skin tone as face

color.highlights: lighter brown #4A3228 on facet plane tops catching key light

hair.style: short, voluminous, messy layered cut with geometric fringe/bangs

geometry_critical.description: built from large flat angular geometric planes and chunky mesh facets
geometry_critical.shapes: triangular and trapezoid hair chunks with visible hard plane breaks
geometry_critical.crown: several large flat-faced polygonal shapes at top

hoodie.fit: loose, dropped shoulders, long sleeves bunched slightly at wrists
hoodie.hood: down, resting on upper back — hood outline visible behind neck
hoodie.drawstrings: two thin cream strings with small metal aglets at chest
hoodie.kangaroo_pocket: single large front pouch with subtle seam
hoodie.fabric: soft cotton fleece, matte, gentle fold shadows at elbows and waist

left_sleeve_logo.position: outer left upper arm — character's left sleeve, viewer's right when facing character
left_sleeve_logo.shape: small stylized six-pointed star or sun burst
left_sleeve_logo.size: small accent emblem — ~2cm at character scale, not a large patch

pants.details: minimal — single center seam per leg, slight stack/fold at ankles above shoes

shoes.sole: thick white rubber platform sole #F0F0F0, ~2cm visible height
shoes.accent: one horizontal sky-blue stripe #42A5F5 across mid-foot / outer side of each shoe
shoes.laces: white flat laces, simple tied bow

tablet.object: plain rectangular tablet device — small iPad form factor
tablet.screen: blank dark grey glass — no icons, no text, no UI, no glow
tablet.held_by: left arm, pressed against left side of torso under folded forearm

silhouette.read: chunky chibi outline — big round head, wide hoodie shoulders tapering to narrow ankles, sneakers anchoring bottom

forbidden_in_image: text or logos except orange sleeve emblem

criteria: no AI mush or painterly softness
face reads with eyes + mouth only (no nose)

regeneration_prompt: Original 3D chibi brand mascot for Filipino career-guidance app KursoKo. 3D stylized toon-shaded vinyl figure, bold clean black outlines on silhouette and features, matte materials, soft upper-left studio lighting. Chibi proportions: oversized head 2.5× torso, short limbs, full body head to sneakers, age 17-22 slim student. POSE: standing three-quarter view body and face turned toward LEFT, right hand fist under chin in thoughtful gesture, left forearm across chest holding dark grey rectangular tablet vertically (iPad shape, blank screen). FACE: warm light tan Filipino youth skin, large round dark brown eyes with two white catchlights each, thick arched dark eyebrows, small gentle closed smile. NO NOSE — completely absent, smooth skin plane between eyes and mouth. HAIR: dark chocolate brown, low-poly faceted 3D sculpt with large angular geometric planes and chunky mesh facets, blocky fringe. OUTFIT: oversized cream off-white pullover hoodie hood down, small bright orange six-point sun on LEFT upper sleeve, dark navy straight-leg pants, white sneakers thick white sole with horizontal sky-blue stripe. Transparent PNG background, no floor, no shadow blob, 1024×1365 portrait.
negative_prompt: nose, nostrils, nose bridge, nose line, nose shadow, 2D anime illustration, manga, Studio Ghibli, watercolor, AI slop, soft anime hair strands, clipboard, paper, notebook, clouds, blobs, stars, floor, ground shadow, photorealistic human, extra limbs, cropped feet, text, watermark, copyrighted game character
